cardOverview.overviewText: The DCB PayLess Platinum Credit Card is a secured RuPay card backed by your DCB Bank fixed deposit, offering easy access to credit even without a credit history and rewards like quarterly cashback, fuel surcharge waivers and complimentary domestic airport lounge access.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
